Subject: Payment cadence request for upcoming SOW

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As we discussed with procurement, NovusMed needs to align the payment cadence to our fiscal quarters. Their procurement team has asked if we can accept a split-remit structure: 25% on signing, then three quarterly invoices tied to milestone acceptance (effectively quarterly billing across the contract year).

Separately, their accounting policy standard is Net-90 for contracted vendors that pass a credit review. Given the size of this engagement (~$1.1M ARR first year) they are requesting Net-90 instead of our standard Net-30.

They can commit to: 25% upfront on signature, formal milestone acceptance criteria, and a single point of contact in accounting (Carlos) to expedite invoices.

Can Redwood provide an exception to Net-30 and accept Net-90 with those concessions? If needed, they are open to a short-term alternative (Net-60 for first two invoices followed by Net-90) but prefer Net-90 given internal cashflow cycles.

I attached the SOW and a proposed payment schedule for your reference.

Best,
Elena
Director of Procurement
NovusMed

Laura / Marissa —

Quick assessment from Deal Desk after reviewing the SOW and NovusMed's proposed schedule:

- Net-90 increases DSO risk materially for a $1.1M first-year engagement.
- Proposed mitigation that would make this acceptable to Deal Desk and Finance:
  * 25% upfront on signature (already agreed)
  * 25% after milestone 1 (end of Q1) — tied to objective acceptance criteria in SOW
  * Remaining 50% split across Q2/Q3 invoices (quarterly remit)
  * Require a basic credit check and a signed payment covenant in the contract

- Concessions: we should NOT give an additional percentage discount for Net-90. If procurement insists on any discount in exchange for Net-90, recommend limiting to a one-time, capped commercial credit tied to early payment.

Attached: Proposed_Payment_Schedule_NovusMed.xlsx (suggested invoice dates & amounts).

If this is escalated, Deal Desk recommends executive sign-off with the above conditions or ask for a Letter of Credit (LOC) for full Net-90.

Laura / team —

Finance view: exposure with full Net-90 on ~$1.1M is significant (approx. $990k outstanding after 25% up front). We can consider a conditional exception but need stronger mitigants. Options we should consider and present to execs:

1) Require 50% upfront instead of 25% if customer insists on Net-90 for the balance. That reduces exposure immediately.
2) Keep 25% upfront but require a Letter of Credit or a bank guarantee for the amounts invoiced beyond Net-60.
3) Approve Net-60 for the first two invoices and move to Net-90 only after a successful milestone acceptance and completed credit review.

If we escalate to Executive Approval, request they weigh business value against capital exposure and confirm acceptable mitigations. Approving Net-90 without an LOC or higher upfront would increase finance cost and requires a temporary increase to our bad debt reserve.

Rishi
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Laura / team —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. After weighing the strategic value of NovusMed and the risk mitigations recommended by Deal Desk and Finance, I approve a conditional Net-90 exception with the following mandatory controls:

1) Payment terms: 25% upfront at signature, then milestone-triggered quarterly invoices as proposed. Remaining balance may move to Net-90 only after successful acceptance of Milestone 1.
2) Mitigant: NovusMed must sign a Payment Covenant and authorize a third-party basic credit check before SOW execution. If credit check fails, we require 50% upfront.
3) Contract language: include explicit milestone acceptance criteria, invoice dispute timeline tightened to 10 business days, and a capped commercial credit (no additional percent discount).
4) Executive sign-off: Redwood Rev Ops leader (Marissa Cole) will approve the commercial terms; legal to add clauses and Aditya to coordinate finance setup (AR terms).

Aditya — can you please prepare the DocuSign envelope with the modified SOW and the Payment Covenant? Priyom / Rishi — attach the revised payment schedule and credit-check authorization to the HubSpot deal. Laura — please confirm with Elena that these controls are acceptable and push for the LOC if procurement insists on immediate Net-90 without the milestone guardrail.

I'll mark this as approved on the deal record once documents are attached.
